_meta.purpose: Tests pipeline robustness across non-Hindi Indian languages. Validates that STT + LLM handles linguistic diversity.

cases.transcript: माझ्या छातीत खूप दुखतंय. श्वास घेताना त्रास होतोय. घाम येतोय. मला खूप भीती वाटतेय.
cases.transcript_romanized: Majhya chhati t khup dukhantay. Shwaas gheta na traas hotoye. Ghaam yetoye. Mala khup bhiti vatateye.
cases.transcript_english: My chest is hurting a lot. I am having trouble breathing. I am sweating. I am very scared.
cases.clinical_notes: Cardiac emergency triad in Marathi. Tests language detection and symptom extraction across languages. Same clinical urgency as CASE_HI_001.

cases.transcript: माझ्या मुलाला खूप ताप आहे, एकशे चार डिग्री. तो बेशुद्ध पडलाय आणि झटके येत आहेत. तो पाच वर्षांचा आहे.
cases.transcript_romanized: Majhya mulala khup taap aahe, ekashe char degree. To beshudh padlay aani jhatke yet aahet. To paach varshanche aahe.
cases.transcript_english: My son has a very high fever, one hundred and four degrees. He has lost consciousness and is having convulsions. He is five years old.
cases.clinical_notes: Same pediatric emergency as CASE_HI_003 but in Marathi. Validates cross-language emergency detection.

cases.transcript: मला तीन दिवसांपासून खूप ताप आहे. पोटावर लाल डाग आले आहेत. हिरड्यांमधून थोडं रक्त येतंय. खूप अशक्त वाटतंय.
cases.transcript_romanized: Mala teen divasampasun khup taap aahe. Potavar laal daag aale aahet. Hiradyanmadun thoda rakt yetay. Khup ashakt vaatatay.
cases.transcript_english: I have had very high fever for three days. Red spots have appeared on the abdomen. There is a little blood from the gums. Feeling very weak.
cases.clinical_notes: Dengue fever suspicion in Marathi. URGENT — General Medicine.

cases.transcript: गुडघ्यात दोन महिन्यांपासून दुखतंय. सकाळी उठल्यावर जास्त त्रास होतो. मी पन्नास वर्षांची आहे.
cases.transcript_romanized: Gudghyat don mahinyanpasun dukhantay. Sakali uthlyavar jaast traas hoto. Mi panna varshachi aahe.
cases.transcript_english: My knee has been hurting for two months. It hurts more when I wake up in the morning. I am fifty years old.
cases.clinical_notes: Routine knee OA in Marathi. Should map to Orthopedics. Tests ROUTINE classification in regional language.

cases.transcript: என் கணவருக்கு திடீரென்று முகம் ஒரு பக்கம் சாய்ந்துவிட்டது. கை தூக்க முடியவில்லை. பேச முடியவில்லை. இது சுமார் பத்து நிமிடங்களுக்கு முன்பு ஆனது.
cases.transcript_romanized: En kanavarukku thideerenbadhu mugam oru pakkam saainthu vittathu. Kai thooka mudiyavillai. Peasa mudiyavillai. Ithu sumaar pathu nimidam mun aanathu.
cases.transcript_english: My husband's face has suddenly drooped to one side. He cannot lift his arm. He cannot speak. This happened about ten minutes ago.
cases.clinical_notes: Stroke FAST criteria in Tamil. Tests Dravidian language handling. EMERGENCY — Neurology.

cases.transcript: எனக்கு மூன்று வாரங்களாக இருமல் இருக்கிறது. இரவில் வியர்வை வருகிறது. எடை குறைந்திருக்கிறது. நேற்று கொஞ்சம் இரத்தம் இருமலில் வந்தது.
cases.transcript_romanized: Enakku moondru varankalaga irumal irukitathu. Iravil viyarva varukitathu. Edai kurandirukkitathu. Netru kondam irattam irumalil vandathu.
cases.transcript_english: I have had a cough for three weeks. I sweat at night. I have lost weight. Yesterday there was a little blood in the cough.
cases.clinical_notes: TB triad in Tamil. Validates CR-05 composite rule. URGENT — Pulmonology.

cases.transcript: నాకు రెండు గంటల నుండి ఛాతీలో చాలా నొప్పిగా ఉంది. చెమట పడుతోంది. శ్వాస తీసుకోవడం కష్టంగా ఉంది. భయంగా ఉంది.
cases.transcript_romanized: Naaku rendu gantala nundi chaatilo chala noppiga undi. Chemata padutundi. Swasa theesukkovadaniki kashtanga undi. Bhayanga undi.
cases.transcript_english: I have been having severe chest pain for two hours. I am sweating. It is difficult to breathe. I am scared.
cases.clinical_notes: Cardiac emergency in Telugu. Tests South Indian language (non-Dravidian Tamil, Dravidian Telugu) handling. EMERGENCY — Cardiology.

cases.transcript: నాకు నాలుగు రోజుల నుండి జ్వరం ఉంది. శరీరమంతా నొప్పి. కళ్ళు పసుపు రంగులో ఉన్నాయి. పొట్ట నొప్పిగా ఉంది.
cases.transcript_romanized: Naaku naalugu roja nundi jvaram undi. Shariramanth noppi. Kalllu pasupu rangulo unnaayi. Potta noppiga undi.
cases.transcript_english: I have had a fever for four days. My whole body hurts. My eyes are yellow. My stomach is hurting.
cases.clinical_notes: Jaundice with fever — hepatitis or leptospirosis likely. URGENT — Gastroenterology.

cases.transcript: আমার বুকে খুব ব্যথা হচ্ছে। শ্বাস নিতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে। ঘাম হচ্ছে। বাম হাতে ব্যথা যাচ্ছে।
cases.transcript_romanized: Aamar buke khub byatha hocche. Shwaas nite koshto hocche. Ghaam hocche. Baam haate byatha jacche.
cases.transcript_english: My chest is hurting a lot. I am having trouble breathing. I am sweating. Pain is going to the left arm.
cases.clinical_notes: ACS presentation in Bengali (Eastern India). Tests language diversity. EMERGENCY — Cardiology.

cases.transcript: আমার সর্দি কাশি হয়েছে দুদিন ধরে। হালকা জ্বর আছে — নিরানব্বই ডিগ্রি। গলা ব্যথা আছে। বিশেষ কোনো সমস্যা নেই।
cases.transcript_romanized: Aamar sordi kashi hoyeche du-din dhore. Halka jor aache — niranobboy degree. Gola byatha aache. Bishesh kono shomosya nei.
cases.transcript_english: I have had a cold and cough for two days. There is a mild fever — ninety-nine degrees. I have a sore throat. No special problems.
cases.clinical_notes: Common cold in Bengali. Should correctly classify as ROUTINE. Tests that mild cases are not over-triaged.
